skills: Volume and surface area of 3D shapes

judgments.rationale: Parts (a) and (b) materially assess differentiation and integration, while part (c) awards marks for calculating a cuboid height from volume and dimensions; the geometry skill is material, but trigonometry is not.
The markscheme uses a GDC derivative value to form the normal and then assesses normal-line and distance geometry; it does not award marks for differentiation rules.

Parts (b)-(d) directly assess sinusoidal graph properties, model construction, and intersections, while part (e) explicitly awards marks for percentage error; the late classification omits the assessed percentage-error skill.
The tree branches encode conditional probabilities, part (b) assesses a joint event, and part (c) uses the total-probability equation, so both listed probability skills are materially assessed.
